# Root Cause Analysis — gh-180

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Both build-macos desktop DMG legs (arm64 + x86_64) fail at `Build macOS release` since 2026-10-23 (run 39905803673) with `The package product 'flutter-inappwebview-macos-product' requires minimum platform version 14.0 for the macOS platform, but this target supports a lower version` → no DMGs in v1.0.630.

**Root cause**: Flutter 3.47 stable ships the Swift Package Manager feature **enabled by default** (`features.dart`: `swiftPackageManager` `enabledByDefault: true` on stable). Every fresh CI clone is migrated to SwiftPM at build time, and the tool generates `FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage` at the **macOS 12.0 floor** (`darwin.dart`: `macos => Version(12, 0, null)`), raising it to the app's `MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` (14.0) **only via a best-effort, silent `xcodebuild -showBuildSettings` read** (`build_macos.dart` → `SwiftPackageManager.updateMinimumDeployment`; failures are swallowed — the tool's own comment: "showBuildSettings is reported to occasionally timeout"). The vendored `flutter_inappwebview_macos` rode SwiftPM because its `Package.swift` existed (the opt-in signal) and published a **14.0-floored product** into that 12.0-floored generated package. On 2026-10-23 the self-hosted runner's Xcode updated to 27; the first Xcode-27 run's silent floor-bump read skipped (gh-1798 measured the first-run SwiftPM integration pass at 3365 s), the generated package stayed at 12.0, and Xcode hard-failed the dependency. Nothing in the 10-22→10-23 merge window touched the macOS project, the vendored plugin, the SDK pin, or the workflow (verified: #1785 changed only `js_widget_runtime`/`quickjs_runtime` in `pubspec.lock`; #1794 is app-level Dart) — the moving part was runner-side Xcode 27 meeting the fragile silent-bump mechanism.

**Impact**: Both desktop DMG legs red on every dispatch since 2026-10-23; `Create macOS GitHub Release` skipped → no DMGs in v1.0.630; daily-publish `Leg: CLI + macOS desktop` red. CLI legs unaffected (no SwiftPM involved).

**Fix approach**: Make the macOS release lane deterministic and the floor invariant loud:
1. Pin the `build-macos` job to **pure CocoaPods** — job env `FLUTTER_SWIFT_PACKAGE_MANAGER: "0"` (the feature's env override is read per flutter invocation; with it off the SPM migration skips cleanly: `build_macos.dart` migration guard "The Swift Package Manager feature is off. Skipping..."). Every macOS plugin is already installed and pinned in `flutter_app/macos/Podfile.lock` (all 17 registrant plugins + FlutterMacOS), and the Podfile platform `:osx, '14.0'` — not a silent tool bump — becomes the authority for the effective pod floors.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration). Since gh-1537 there are
  NO main CI runs — "tag-only" is literal: tags/dispatch/schedule only.
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only
  provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets — the per-PR integration

arguments.content:
### Root Cause

Flutter 3.47 stable ships Swift Package Manager **enabled by default**: every fresh clone is migrated at build time and gets `FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage` generated at the **macOS 12.0 floor**, raised to the app's 14.0 only via a best-effort, silent `xcodebuild -showBuildSettings` read (`SwiftPackageManager.updateMinimumDeployment` — failures are swallowed). The vendored `flutter_inappwebview_macos` rode SwiftPM (its `Package.swift` was the opt-in) with a **14.0-floored product**; on 2026-10-23 the runner's Xcode updated to 27, the silent bump skipped on the first Xcode-27 run (gh-1798 measured that first pass at 3365 s), and Xcode hard-failed both desktop legs: `requires minimum platform version 14.0 ... but this target supports a lower version` → no DMGs in v1.0.630. The green→red window's merges never touched the macOS project, vendor, SDK pin, or workflow — the moving part was runner-side Xcode 27 meeting the fragile silent bump.

### Previous Attempt

gh-1798 (PR #1799, commit `dc547f1`) deleted the vendored `Package.swift` (moving the plugin to CocoaPods) and widened the signing keychain window. Insufficient because it only removed today's 14.0 product: the lane still depended on the silent floor bump, so any future plugin/product with a macOS floor in (12.0, 14.0] re-breaks both legs identically — and the required build-time REG assertion was never delivered.

### Fix

- `.github/workflows/build-macos.yml`: job-level `FLUTTER_SWIFT_PACKAGE_MANAGER: "0"` pins both matrix legs to **pure CocoaPods** (every macOS plugin already pinned in `macos/Podfile.lock`; the Podfile platform `:osx, '14.0'`, not a silent bump, is the floor authority); the `Build macOS release` step now runs `flutter build macos --config-only` + the new gate **before** the release build.
- `scripts/assert_macos_min_platform.sh` (new REG gate, fail-loud `::error`): asserts every `MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET`/Podfile platform = 14.0, the vendored `Package.swift` stays deleted, and **no SwiftPM state** exists after the config pass — with the specific gh-180 diagnostic (product floor vs generated floor) if it ever recurs.

### Test Coverage

- `test/macos_min_platform_gate_test.dart` — 12 cases: clean pods-lane pass, the literal gh-180 violation shape, multi-item floor scan (violation in a later manifest), lane-drift and floor-drift failures, graceful missing-file failures, real-repo pass. RED pre-fix, GREEN post-fix.
- `test/build_macos_spm_lane_guard_test.dart` — pins the env pin, gate-before-release ordering, and the committed 3×14.0 pbxproj shape.
- Full suite (`dart test`): N tests passed, 0 failures (see run log); the 9 pre-existing build-macos guard suites (176 tests) unaffected.

### Notes

- The gate runs only in the build-macos job; dev machines with default SwiftPM are unaffected. Both legs get the job env, including the no-sandbox flavor.
- Desktop DMG greenness itself requires a macOS runner dispatch (next build-macos run); this change removes both the failing lane dependency (silent bump) and the 14.0 SwiftPM product from the legs, per the ticket AC.

arguments.content:
### Root Cause

Flutter 3.47 stable ships Swift Package Manager enabled by default: every fresh clone is migrated at build time and gets `FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage` at the **macOS 12.0 floor**, raised to the app's 14.0 only via a best-effort, silent `xcodebuild -showBuildSettings` read (failures swallowed). The vendored `flutter_inappwebview_macos` rode SwiftPM (its `Package.swift` was the opt-in) with a 14.0-floored product; on 2026-10-23 Xcode updated to 27 on the runner, the silent bump skipped on the first Xcode-27 run, and Xcode failed both legs: `requires minimum platform version 14.0 ... but this target supports a lower version`. The window's merges never touched the macOS project/vendor/SDK pin — the moving part was runner-side Xcode 27 meeting the fragile silent bump.

### Previous Attempt

gh-1798 (PR #1799, commit `dc547f1`) deleted the vendored `Package.swift` and widened the keychain window. Insufficient: the lane still depended on the silent floor bump, so any future plugin/product with a macOS floor in (12.0, 14.0] re-breaks both legs identically, and the required build-time REG assertion was never delivered.

### Fix

- `build-macos.yml`: job env `FLUTTER_SWIFT_PACKAGE_MANAGER: "0"` pins both legs to **pure CocoaPods** (all macOS plugins already pinned in `macos/Podfile.lock`; Podfile platform `:osx, '14.0'` is the floor authority); `Build macOS release` now runs `flutter build macos --config-only` + the gate **before** the release build.
- `scripts/assert_macos_min_platform.sh` (new, fail-loud `::error`): every `MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET`/Podfile platform = 14.0; the vendored `Package.swift` stays deleted; **no SwiftPM state** after the config pass — with the specific gh-180 diagnostic if it recurs.

### Test Coverage

- `test/macos_min_platform_gate_test.dart` (12 cases) — RED before the fix, GREEN after; covers the literal gh-180 shape + multi-item floor scan.
- `test/build_macos_spm_lane_guard_test.dart` — pins the env pin, gate-before-release order, committed 3×14.0 pbxproj shape.
- Full suite: green, 0 failures (counts in the run log).

### Notes

- Gate runs only in the build-macos job; dev machines unaffected. Both legs (incl. no-sandbox flavor) inherit the job env.
- DMG greenness needs the next macOS dispatch; this removes the failing lane dependency and the 14.0 SwiftPM product from the legs.

arguments.content:
### Root Cause

Flutter 3.47 stable ships Swift Package Manager enabled by default: every fresh clone is migrated at build time and gets `FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage` at the **macOS 12.0 floor**, raised to the app's 14.0 only via a best-effort, silent `xcodebuild -showBuildSettings` read (failures swallowed). The vendored `flutter_inappwebview_macos` rode SwiftPM (its `Package.swift` was the opt-in) with a 14.0-floored product; on 2026-10-23 Xcode updated to 27 on the runner, the silent bump skipped on the first Xcode-27 run, and Xcode failed both legs: `requires minimum platform version 14.0 ... but this target supports a lower version`. The window's merges never touched the macOS project/vendor/SDK pin — the moving part was runner-side Xcode 27 meeting the fragile silent bump.

### Previous Attempt

gh-1798 (PR #1799, commit `dc547f1`) deleted the vendored `Package.swift` and widened the keychain window. Insufficient: the lane still depended on the silent floor bump, so any future plugin/product with a macOS floor in (12.0, 14.0] re-breaks both legs identically, and the required build-time REG assertion was never delivered.

### Fix

- `build-macos.yml`: job env `FLUTTER_SWIFT_PACKAGE_MANAGER: "0"` pins both legs to **pure CocoaPods** (all macOS plugins already pinned in `macos/Podfile.lock`; Podfile platform `:osx, '14.0'` is the floor authority); `Build macOS release` now runs `flutter build macos --config-only` + the gate **before** the release build.
- `scripts/assert_macos_min_platform.sh` (new, fail-loud `::error`): every `MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET`/Podfile platform = 14.0; the vendored `Package.swift` stays deleted; **no SwiftPM state** after the config pass — with the specific gh-180 diagnostic if it recurs.

### Test Coverage

- `test/macos_min_platform_gate_test.dart` (12 cases) — RED before the fix, GREEN after; covers the literal gh-180 shape + multi-item floor scan (violation in a later manifest).
- `test/build_macos_spm_lane_guard_test.dart` — pins the env pin, gate-before-release order, committed 3×14.0 pbxproj shape.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **12062 passed, 0 product failures** (12 skips; one unrelated perf-budget test `wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` tripped at 142 ms/100 ms under a contended 4-core box mid-run and passes 14/14 on an idle re-run — same contention sensitivity gh-1785 reworked). The 9 pre-existing build-macos guard suites: 176 passed.

### Notes

- Gate runs only in the build-macos job; dev machines with default SwiftPM are unaffected. Both legs (incl. the no-sandbox flavor) inherit the job env.
- DMG greenness needs the next macOS dispatch; this removes the failing lane dependency and the 14.0 SwiftPM product from the legs.

arguments.content:
### Root Cause

Flutter 3.47 stable ships Swift Package Manager enabled by default: every fresh clone is migrated at build time and gets `FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage` at the **macOS 12.0 floor**, raised to the app's 14.0 only via a best-effort, silent `xcodebuild -showBuildSettings` read (failures swallowed). The vendored `flutter_inappwebview_macos` rode SwiftPM (its `Package.swift` was the opt-in) with a 14.0-floored product; on 2026-10-23 Xcode updated to 27 on the runner, the silent bump skipped on the first Xcode-27 run, and Xcode failed both legs: `requires minimum platform version 14.0 ... but this target supports a lower version`. The window's merges never touched the macOS project/vendor/SDK pin — the moving part was runner-side Xcode 27 meeting the fragile silent bump.

### Previous Attempt

gh-1798 (PR #1799, commit `dc547f1`) deleted the vendored `Package.swift` and widened the keychain window. Insufficient: the lane still depended on the silent floor bump, so any future plugin/product with a macOS floor in (12.0, 14.0] re-breaks both legs identically, and the required build-time REG assertion was never delivered.

### Fix

- `build-macos.yml`: job env `FLUTER_SWIFT_PACKAGE_MANAGER: "0"` pins both legs (incl. the no-sandbox flavor) to **pure CocoaPods** — every macOS plugin is already pinned in `macos/Podfile.lock`, so the Podfile platform `:osx, '14.0'`, not a silent tool bump, is the floor authority. `Build macOS release` now runs `flutter build macos --config-only` (the tool's real SPM/pods config pass, no compile) + the new gate **before** the release build.
- `scripts/assert_macos_min_platform.sh` (new, fail-loud `::error`): every `MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET`/Podfile platform = 14.0; the vendored `Package.swift` stays deleted; **no SwiftPM state** after the config pass — with the specific gh-180 diagnostic (product floor vs generated floor) if it ever recurs.

### Test Coverage

- `test/macos_min_platform_gate_test.dart` (12 cases, RED before the fix / GREEN after — literal gh-180 shape + multi-item floor scan) and `test/build_macos_spm_lane_guard_test.dart` (env pin, gate-before-release order, committed 3×14.0 pbxproj shape).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **12062 passed, 0 product failures** (12 skips; the unrelated `wrap_ansi_line_perf` budget tripped at 142 ms/100 ms under a contended box mid-run and passes 14/14 idle — the gh-1785-known contention sensitivity). Pre-existing build-macos guard suites: 176 passed.

### Notes

- The gate runs only in the build-macos job; dev machines with default SwiftPM are unaffected.
- DMG greenness needs the next macOS dispatch; this removes the failing lane dependency and the 14.0 SwiftPM product from the legs.

21 outputs/response.md
### Root Cause

Flutter 3.47 stable ships Swift Package Manager enabled by default: every fresh clone is migrated at build time and gets `FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage` at the **macOS 12.0 floor**, raised to the app's 14.0 only via a best-effort, silent `xcodebuild -showBuildSettings` read (failures swallowed). The vendored `flutter_inappwebview_macos` rode SwiftPM (its `Package.swift` was the opt-in) with a 14.0-floored product; on 2026-10-23 Xcode updated to 27 on the runner, the silent bump skipped on the first Xcode-27 run, and Xcode failed both legs: `requires minimum platform version 14.0 ... but this target supports a lower version`. The window's merges never touched the macOS project/vendor/SDK pin — the moving part was runner-side Xcode 27 meeting the fragile silent bump.

### Previous Attempt

gh-1798 (PR #1799, commit `dc547f1`) deleted the vendored `Package.swift` and widened the keychain window. Insufficient: the lane still depended on the silent floor bump, so any future plugin/product with a macOS floor in (12.0, 14.0] re-breaks both legs identically, and the required build-time REG assertion was never delivered.

### Fix

- `build-macos.yml`: job env `FLUTER_SWIFT_PACKAGE_MANAGER: "0"` pins both legs (incl. the no-sandbox flavor) to **pure CocoaPods** — every macOS plugin is already pinned in `macos/Podfile.lock`, so the Podfile platform `:osx, '14.0'`, not a silent tool bump, is the floor authority. `Build macOS release` now runs `flutter build macos --config-only` (the tool's real SPM/pods config pass, no compile) + the new gate **before** the release build.
- `scripts/assert_macos_min_platform.sh` (new, fail-loud `::error`): every `MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET`/Podfile platform = 14.0; the vendored `Package.swift` stays deleted; **no SwiftPM state** after the config pass — with the specific gh-180 diagnostic (product floor vs generated floor) if it ever recurs.

### Test Coverage

- `test/macos_min_platform_gate_test.dart` (12 cases, RED before the fix / GREEN after — literal gh-180 shape + multi-item floor scan) and `test/build_macos_spm_lane_guard_test.dart` (env pin, gate-before-release order, committed 3×14.0 pbxproj shape).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **12062 passed, 0 product failures** (12 skips; the unrelated `wrap_ansi_line_perf` budget tripped at 142 ms/100 ms under a contended box mid-run and passes 14/14 idle — the gh-1785-known contention sensitivity). Pre-existing build-macos guard suites: 176 passed.

### Notes

- Gate runs only in the build-macos job (dev machines with default SwiftPM unaffected); DMG greenness needs the next macOS dispatch — this removes the failing lane dependency and the 14.0 SwiftPM product from the legs.

## Summary

**gh-180 — Desktop DMG legs red (`flutter-inappwebview-macos-product` min macOS 14.0 vs lower-target build phase)**

**Root cause (pinned to exact code):** Flutter 3.47.7 stable ships the SwiftPM feature **enabled by default** (`features.dart`: `enabledByDefault: true`), migrates the fresh CI clone at build time, and generates `FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage` at the **macOS 12.0 floor** (`darwin.dart`: `macos => Version(12, 0, null)`). The tool bumps it to the app's 14.0 **only** via a best-effort, silent `xcodebuild -showBuildSettings` read (`build_macos.dart` → `updateMinimumDeployment`; failures swallowed). The vendored `flutter_inappwebview_macos` rode SwiftPM (its `Package.swift` was the opt-in signal) with a 14.0-floored product; on 2026-10-23 the runner's Xcode updated to 27, the first Xcode-27 run's silent bump skipped (gh-1798 measured that first pass at 3365 s), and Xcode hard-failed the dependency. The window's merges never touched the macOS project/vendor/SDK pin — verified by diffing #1785/#1794: the moving part was runner-side Xcode 27 meeting the fragile silent bump.

**Previous attempt (gh-1798, PR #1799, `dc547f1`):** deleted the vendored `Package.swift` + widened the keychain window. Insufficient: the lane still depended on the same silent bump — any future plugin/product with a macOS floor in (12.0, 14.0] re-breaks both legs identically — and the required build-time REG assertion was never delivered.

**Fix (TDD, RED→GREEN):**
1. `build-macos.yml` — job env `FLUTTER_SWIFT_PACKAGE_MANAGER: "0"` pins both matrix legs (and the no-sandbox flavor) to **pure CocoaPods**; every macOS plugin is already locked in `Podfile.lock`, so the Podfile platform `:osx, '14.0'` — not a silent tool bump — is the floor authority. `Build macOS release` runs `flutter build macos --config-only` + the new gate **before** the release build.
2. `scripts/assert_macos_min_platform.sh` (new, `+x`, fail-loud `::error`) — app floor 14.0 in pbxproj + Podfile, vendored `Package.swift` stays deleted, **no SwiftPM state** after the config pass; on recurrence it emits the specific product-vs-generated-floor diagnostic (the literal gh-180 error shape) with the lane remediation — in seconds, not after a 50-minute pass.
3. `test/macos_min_platform_gate_test.dart` (12 cases — confirmed RED pre-fix) + `test/build_macos_spm_lane_guard_test.dart`, auto-picked-up by the CI core shards.

**Verification:** new suites 15/15 (plus neutral-env parity re-run); 9 pre-existing build-macos guard suites 176/176; canonical suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **12062 passed, 0 product failures** (the one perf-budget trip was contention-induced and passes 14/14 idle); `dart format`/`dart analyze` clean; completion guard satisfied (3 commits beyond `origin/main`, tree clean, no closing keywords). The runtime leg-green confirmation requires the next build-macos dispatch on the self-hosted macOS runner, which this session cannot trigger — noted in `outputs/response.md`.

## Final Summary — gh-180

**Root cause:** Flutter 3.47.7 stable ships SwiftPM **enabled by default**; every fresh clone is migrated at build time and gets `FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage` at the **macOS 12.0 floor**, raised to the app's 14.0 only via a best-effort, silent `xcodebuild -showBuildSettings` read (failures swallowed — `build_macos.dart` → `updateMinimumDeployment`). The vendored `flutter_inappwebview_macos` rode SwiftPM (its `Package.swift` was the opt-in) with a 14.0-floored product; on 2026-10-23 the runner's Xcode updated to 27, the silent bump skipped on the first Xcode-27 run, and Xcode failed both legs. The window's merges never touched the macOS project/vendor/SDK pin (verified by diffing #1785/#1794) — the moving part was runner-side Xcode 27 meeting the fragile silent bump.

**Previous attempt (gh-1798, PR #1799, `dc547f1`)** deleted the vendored `Package.swift` but left the lane dependent on the same silent bump — any future plugin/product with a floor in (12.0, 14.0] re-breaks both legs identically — and never delivered the required build-time REG gate.

**Fix:** `build-macos.yml` job env `FLUTTER_SWIFT_PACKAGE_MANAGER: "0"` (pure CocoaPods lane — every macOS plugin already pinned in `Podfile.lock`; Podfile platform `:osx, '14.0'` is the floor authority) + `Build macOS release` now runs `flutter build macos --config-only` and the new `scripts/assert_macos_min_platform.sh` gate **before** the release build; the gate fails loud (`::error`) on any floor drift, vendored `Package.swift` reappearance, or SwiftPM state after the config pass — with the specific gh-180 diagnostic on recurrence.

**Verification:** repro tests RED pre-fix → 15/15 GREEN post-fix (incl. neutral-env parity run); 9 pre-existing build-macos guard suites 176/176; canonical suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` 12062 passed / 0 product failures (one unrelated contention-sensitive perf budget re-verified 14/14 idle); format/analyze clean; completion guard satisfied. The runtime leg-green confirmation requires the next build-macos dispatch on the self-hosted macOS runner — flagged in `outputs/response.md`.
